content.rendered:
Questions, bug reports, tool requests, or business inquiries — this is the fastest way to reach us. Messages land directly in our inbox and we read every one.

What to include

  • Found a bug? Tell us which tool, what you did, and what happened — your browser and device help too.
  • Missing a tool? Describe the job you’re trying to get done and we’ll consider building it.
  • Business or partnership? A sentence or two about who you are and what you have in mind is plenty.

    We typically reply within a couple of business days. Note: we never ask for passwords or payment details — everything on How7o is free.
